#include <iostream>
#include <sstream>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <stack>
#include <string>
#include <utility>
#include <cassert>
#include <cstring>
#include <ctime>
#include <cmath>

#define pairII pair<int, int> 
#define VP vector<pairII > 
#define VL vector<long long>
#define VVL vector<VL >
#define VD vector<double>
#define VVD vector<VD >
#define VI vector<int>
#define VVI vector<VI >
#define VVVI vector<VVI >
#define VB vector<bool>
#define VVB vector<VB >
#define forN(i, n) for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i)
#define rforN(i, n) for (int i = n; i >= 0; --i)
#define forR(i, l, r) for (int i = l; i <= r; ++i)
#define rforR(i, r, l) for (int i = r; i >= l; --i)
#define forV(i, Vec, type) for (type::iterator (i) = (Vec).begin(); (i) < (Vec).end(); ++(i))
#define rforV(i, Vec, type) for (type::reverse_iterator (i) = (Vec).rbegin(); (i) < (Vec).rend(); ++(i))
#define INF 1e9
#define pb push_back
#define mp make_pair
#define min3(a, b, c) min( (a), min ( (b), (c) ))
#define PI = acos(-1.0)

using namespace std;     

string phone, ans;
vector<pair<int, string> > pos;

void find (int i = 0, int balance = 0) {
	if (i == pos.size ()) {
		if (phone.find ('@') == phone.rfind ('@') && phone.rfind ('@') != string::npos) {
			cout << phone;
			exit (0);
		}
		return;
	}
	phone.replace (pos[i].first + balance, (pos[i].second == "@" ? 2 : 3), pos[i].second);
	find (i + 1, balance - (pos[i].second == "@" ? 1 : 2));
	phone.replace (pos[i].first + balance, 1, (pos[i].second == "@" ? "at" : "dot"));
	
	find (i + 1, balance);
}

int main() {
//	freopen ("in.txt", "r", stdin);
//	freopen ("out.txt", "w", stdout);
	
	cin >> phone;
	forN (i, phone.length ()) 
		if (i + 3 < phone.length () && i > 0 && phone.substr (i, 3) == "dot")
			pos.pb (mp (i, "."));
		else if (i + 2 < phone.length () && i > 0 && phone.substr (i, 2) == "at")
			pos.pb (mp (i, "@"));
	find ();
	return 0;
}
